subject: Game Theory
title: The Cooperation Puzzle
description: A quick win: understand The Cooperation Puzzle.

hook.text: Two hunters can catch a stag together or chase rabbits alone. Together pays more, but alone is safer.

buildup.text: The stag hunt shows why cooperation is risky: it requires trusting the other person to do their part.

discovery.text: Unlike the prisoner's dilemma, both players prefer cooperation. The problem isn't incentives—it's trust.

twist.text: One bad experience makes everyone hunt rabbits. Trust is easy to lose and painfully slow to rebuild.

climax.text: The stag hunt models real life: startups need cofounders, nations need allies, teams need commitment.

punchline.text: Cooperation pays, but only if both show up.

quiz.question: What makes the stag hunt different from the prisoner's dilemma?
